as_told.title: Classified cell phone videos of triangles

plain: A man named Dylan Borland, talking to the podcast host Jesse Michels, says he knows for a fact that the US government holds mobile phone videos of the triangles, the large triangle-shaped craft people report seeing in the sky. He calls the footage undeniable and says it would settle the question once and for all. In another part of the talk he calls the videos classified but doesn't say who holds them or how close they were filmed. If he is right, there would be hard proof sitting in official hands.
